plan.notes: Source: King's College official 2026-2027 Computer Science major planner PDF (https://www.kings.edu/pdf/major-planners/2026-27/2026-2027-computer-science.pdf), effective 07/01/2026, Catalog 2026-2027. True degree: Bachelor of Science (BS.CS). Transcription method: PDF downloaded 2026-09-30 from www.kings.edu (official domain); both pages (requirements front + suggested-sequence reverse) extracted and manually transcribed. Credit check: 14+17+17+17+15+15+15+12 = 122, matching the catalog's published 'Total Credits Required for Graduation = 122' (college baccalaureate minimum is 120; CS requires 122). No sequence-vs-degree-minimum discrepancy. The planner's generic 'Core Course' rows are transcribed as student-choice slots mapped to the planner's 15 Core Requirement areas (45 cr total); Quantitative Reasoning is satisfied by major (MATH 127/MATH 129) per planner note 2. CS 481 OR CS 499 capstone and six CS electives per catalog footnote (max 2 CIS electives). Courses flagged 'PR' in the planner are not expanded into per-course prereq chains here (planner says 'check college catalog') - no invention. Placement note (not a prereq): students may be required to take ENGL 105 and/or MATH 100 based on placement exams; those are 3 credits each counting as free electives. Optional parenthetical rows ('(Core Course) (3)' Fall Y1, '(Core Course OR Free Elective - if needed) (3)' Spring Y4) are not part of the base 122 and are not transcribed. Standard semester load 15-17 credits per planner note; 18 allowed when a lab pushes over 17.
